comment: EP-174 M5: every fixture application the acceptance runs deploy, with the bindings its nagare/Config.hs declares written out explicitly. `just fixture-smoke` builds each image, starts the declared backing services, runs the app with only those variables and probes it. A new or corrected fixture is added here and smoke-run before any cluster sees it.
